label: RELATION_RELATIVE_POSSIBLE_FULFILLMENT_2: Can available w p means there exists v with…
definition: Can available w p means there exists v with available.access w v and p v. Accessibility is an explicit input. Logical possibility, feasible continuation and the selected actual continuation require different intended relations; the definition does not assert any of them coincides. No temporal or agency axioms are implicit.
note: Separate from ideal-successor obligation and from moral permission. Complete continuation profiles are used only as small controls.
